title: Surreal Dragon Music Scene
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a green and gold dragon on a stage breathing a swirling stream of colorful musical notes that flow across the room. In the foreground, an open desk drawer reveals a flashlight, rings, and a note reading 'If the music is too loud you're too old', while the background shows a circus tent, windmill, and hallway under a purple night sky.
prompt: surreal fantasy scene of a large ornate green and gold dragon on a wooden stage breathing a swirling rainbow stream of musical notes and symbols that flow through a dark room, open desk drawer in foreground containing a flashlight and note saying If the music is too loud you're too old, background features a red and yellow circus tent, purple windmill, glowing mushrooms, red theater seats, all under a deep purple night sky, whimsical and detailed digital painting
